about_the_game:
A seventeen-page artbook in PDF format containing character concepts and sketches from the game.

In this artbook, you'll uncover:

- What the Sefirot of Death and Fire looks like

- How many wings each incarnation of the Sefirot carries

- Why the Dayfly was originally named Paula

- Which ending could be considered the "true" one

...and so much more about the enigmatic world of Sefirot and Dayflies.

As a gift you'll receive two exclusive avatars featuring the main heroines of the game.

All content in the artbook is presented in both Russian and English.

You can find the artbook inside your Steam game folder. For example:

"C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\The Day in a Life of a Dayfly\Art"

Thank you so much for supporting the project!
